question_pt: Quais sao os 3 CIDs com maior taxa de mortalidade em cada estado MA e RS, considerando CIDs com mais de 1000 internacoes?
ground_truth_sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT m."SG_UF" AS uf, c."DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i."MUNIC_RES" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE m."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY m."SG_UF", c."DESCRICAO" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uf ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade DESC, total_internacoes DESC) AS rn FROM agg) SELECT uf, diagnostico, total_internacoes, total_mortes, taxa_mortalidade FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY uf, rn;
